children: BillionToOne reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $123M, up 47.2% from $83.5M a year earlier, while net income rose to $17.4M from $5.7M and diluted EPS increased to $0.32 from $0.1. Revenue growth reflected higher test volumes and average selling prices, including prior-period claim reprocessing.
Revenue was $123.0M, compared with $83.5M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 47.2%.
Net income was $17.4M, compared with $5.7M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 204.5%.
Diluted EPS was $0.32, compared with $0.10 in the prior-year quarter.
Revenue increased 47% year over year, supported by 25% more delivered tests and an 18% increase in average selling price.
Prenatal tests accounted for 87% of revenue in the first nine months of 2026. Oncology represented 12%, up from 8% a year earlier.
The company recorded about 206,000 billable tests in the quarter and processed roughly 770,000 tests in the 12 months ended September 2026.
UNITY Confirm launched in May. Northstar PGx and Select CH also launched, and Northstar Origin was announced for August 2026.
Austin laboratory space is expected to open for testing in 2028, while the new Union City oncology laboratory is expected to be occupied in 2027.
